subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

The children are making colorful decorations for the upcoming school festival.

options.text: Colorful decorations are made by the children for the upcoming school festival.
Colorful decorations are being made by the children for the upcoming school festival
Colorful decorations were being made by the children for the upcoming school festival.
Colorful decorations have been made by the children for the upcoming school festival.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Colorful decorations are being made by the children for the upcoming school festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present continuous tense**, as indicated by the use of "are making."
 
• To convert a sentence from active to passive voice in the present continuous tense:
 
 
• The structure changes to: **Object + is/are/am + being + past participle + by + subject.**
 
 
 
• In the given sentence:
 
 
• **Active voice:** The children are making colorful decorations for the upcoming school festival.
 
• **Object:** Colorful decorations
 
• **Verb:** are making → are being made (in passive voice)
 
• **Subject:** The children → by the children
 
 

Correct sentence: *Colorful decorations are being made by the children for the upcoming school festival*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive voice structure for tenses:**
 
 
• **Present Simple:** Object + is/are/am + past participle
 
 
• **Example:** The letter is written by John.
 
 
 
• **Present Continuous:** Object + is/are/am + being + past participle
 
 
• **Example:** The book is being read by Mary.
 
 
 
• **Present Perfect:** Object + has/have + been + past participle
 
 
• **Example:** The homework has been completed by the students.
